8.1
INTRODUCTION
It is very important to know how to select the fabric for any garment because the same
kind of fabric can not be used for all types of garments. There are some garments which
.require particular type offabric. Kurta-Pajama or a gown can be made of poplin or long
cloth but a pant can not be made ofthese fabrics. A pant needs a thicker fabric which

8.3
SELECTION OF FABRIC FOR GARMENTS
There are some points about selection of fabricwhich should always be kept in mind while
designing a garment or when advising a customer about a garment, These are -
1.
Colour and taxture
While selectingthe colour andtexture ofthe fabric,alwaysconsiderthe complexion

and the build of the person who will wear the garment. The colour selected should
suit the wearer and the texture of the fabric will depend on the figure of the
wearer.
2.
Design
The age and the social status of the person influence the selection of the design
of the fabric.
.
3.
Age of wearer
The age of the wearer influences the selection of the fabric. For example, nursery
prints or flowery designs in large prints and bright coloursare
appropriate for
children's garments. Ladies prefer light designs while light colours, thin stripes and
small checks seem more app~opriate for older persons. The persons of older age
group also prefer loose garments hence the fabric selected should be fine and
light
- 4.
Occupation
People working in offices prefer to wear plain clothes in light colours whereas
workmen would want their garments to be made of thick fabrics in dark colours.
Hence the occupation of the person influences the selection of fabric.
5.
Occassions
Brigthly coloured fabric in bold designs seem more appropriate for festivals and
other happy occassions whereas black or plain white seems more suitable for
unhappy or unfortunate incidents like death, etc.
While selecting a fabric, please check to see that -
1)
the fabric has an even weave
2)
that the design is well done throughout the fabric.
8.4
SELECTION OF FABRIC FOR DIFFERENT
GARMENTS
There are some points to consider while selecting the fabric for different garments if we
want the final garment to look attractive and good to wear. These are -
1.
Frock
Children garments need a soft fabric. Fabrics like rubia, crepe, cotton, terrycot,

flannel, voil, poplin, etc. can be used for making frocks. Silk and organdy can also'
be used for making frocks but they should be used with a lining so that the stiff
fabric does not hurt the skin. Nowadays cotswo()l and satin are also used to make
winter frocks.
2.
Night suit
These are used at night. Fabrics like flannel, wash-n-wear, rubia, terrycot and voil
can be used to make night suits.
3.
Skirt
Fabric like terrycot or cotton canbe used to make skirts. Slightly thicker fabrics
are used to make pleated and divided skirts so that the pleats can be properly
pressed and set into place. For these, tussar, khadi, crepe, corduroy, etc. fabrics
can be used.
4.
, Pant (jeans)
Thick fabrics are used to make' pant (jeans). The denim fabric is used to make
jeans. Denim is of two kinds - one is soft and the other is slightly rougher. The
soft denim is used to make jeans for children. Fabrics like drill, tussar, khadi,
crepe and corduroy are used for making pants and knickers.
5.
Gent's shirt
A wide variety of fabrics can be used to make gents shirts, such as - terrycot,'
serge, cotswool, cotton, khadi, silk, etc. The fabric chosen can be thu..~ r-: f..He
accc rding to the season.
6.
Gent's kurta pyjama
Fine and soft fabrics are used formaking gent'skurta-pyiamas, Fabrics like terrycot,
poplin, cotton, khadi, silk and mulmul are generally used.
7.
Blouse
Fabrics like rubia, terryrubia, terrycot, terrysilk, silk, etc can be used for making
a blouse. Sometimes sarees have a matching blouse piece but they have to be
made with a lining.
8.
Ladies suit

Nighty (gown)
Soft fabrics are used for making a nighty. Fabrics like terrycot, poplin, khadi,
cotton, etc are used for this purpose. A fine fabric like net can also be used when
making a double set of nighty and gown. Fabrics like linen and cotton can be used
for making gowns.
